_: What this repository's gate reads and builds. The gate is verify.ps1, a pass-through to run.ps1: tool restore, a Fantomas check over src/ and tests/ (against .editorconfig and .fantomasignore), a build of the solution, the Expecto suite (which embeds its corpus copy and reads no file unless FUARAN_PROGRAM_SPEC_CORPUS is set) and a Fable compile of the library. The build reads the MSBuild props, global.json and the projects' sources; the pack-only README is read by the library project's item list.
